fields.description: Issue includes extensive coverage and commentary on a Miami city commission run-off election, including polling comparisons and arguments about candidates and the impact of proposed consolidation of city and county tax assessment offices on residential taxes and homestead exemptions. Additional content addresses the Dade County grand jury report on crime and calls for federal intervention, local law enforcement actions (including pinball machine payoff enforcement and a still investigation), criticism of the Florida sales tax and illegal off-track betting, and reports on the plight of indigent elderly residents seeking affordable rooms. Regular columns, letters to the editor, and local business and entertainment advertising are also present.
